                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        গ্রামে পরিবারের সংখ্যা = 1200টি

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        বিদ্যুতায়নের হার = 75% প্রতি বছর

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2 বছর পর বিদ্যুৎবিহীন পরিবারের সংখ্যা:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 1200 × (100 - 75)% × (100 - 75)%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 1200 × 25/100 × 25/100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 1200 × 1/4 × 1/4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 75

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ 2 বছর পর বিদ্যুৎ সংযোগ ছাড়া বসবাসকারী পরিবারের সংখ্যা 75 হবে।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        વીજળીકરણનો દર = વાર્ષિક 75%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ગણતરી:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2 વર્ષ પછી વીજળી વિનાના ઘરોની સંખ્યા:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 1200 x (100 - 75)% x (100 - 75)%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 1200 x 25/100 x 25/100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 1200 x 1/4 x 1/4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 75

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ 2 વર્ષ પછી વીજળી કનેક્શન વિના રહેતા ઘરોની સંખ્યા 75 હશે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n", "kn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ಗ್ರಾಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಮನೆಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ = 1200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ವಿದ್ಯುದೀಕರಣದ ದರ = ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ 75%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The correct answer is Archimedes' principle.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • When a body is immersed wholly or partially in a liquid, a force is exerted on it in an upward direction, which is equal to the weight of the liquid displaced by that body.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Archimedes' principle makes this clear.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Archimedes' principle states that the upward buoyant force that is exerted on a body immersed in a fluid, whether fully or partially submerged, is equal to the weight of the fluid that the body displaces and acts in the upward direction at the center of mass of the displaced fluid.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Archimedes’ principle, physical law of buoyancy, was discovered by the ancient Greek mathematician and inventor Archimedes, stating that anybody completely or partially submerged in a fluid (gas or liquid) at rest is acted upon by an upward, or buoyant, force, the magnitude of which is equal to the weight of the fluid displaced by the body.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The volume of displaced fluid is equivalent to the volume of an object fully immersed in a fluid or to that fraction of the volume below the surface for an object partially submerged in a liquid.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The weight of the displaced portion of the fluid is equivalent to the magnitude of the buoyant force.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The buoyant force on a body floating in a liquid or gas is also equivalent in magnitude to the weight of the floating object and is opposite in direction; the object neither rises nor sinks.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
